description: Single and two storey side to rear extension; conversion of garage to habitable room; replacement of garage door with window
decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="">The proposed two storey side and rear extension,
by reason of its excessive depth, scale and close proximity to the shared
boundary with No. 118 Headstone Lane, would breach the 45-degree guideline and
result in an unacceptable loss of light and increased overshadowing to the
neighbouring property. The development would therefore cause significant harm
to the living conditions and residential amenity of the occupiers of No. 118
Headstone Lane. As such, the proposal would be contrary to the high-quality
design aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies
D1, D3, D4 of The London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow’s Local Plan
(2021-2041) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary
Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style=""><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; font-size-adjust: none; font-language-override: normal; font-kerning: auto; font-optical-sizing: auto; font-feature-settings: normal; font-variation-settings: normal; font-stretch: normal; line-height: normal;">&nbsp;</span><!--[endif]-->The proposed two storey side to rear extension would
result in an inappropriate roof form due to its overall bulk and design and would
also intersect the existing rear dormer. &nbsp;The proposal, would result in an unduly
obtrusive and incongruous addition to the original dwellinghouse, failing to
respect the character and proportions of the dwellinghouse and the visual
amenities of the locality. The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high-quality
design aspiration of the National Planning Policy Framework (2024), Policies
D1, D3, D4 of The London Plan (2021), Policy GR1 of the Harrow’s Local Plan
(2021-2041) and the relevant provisions of the adopted Harrow Supplementary
Planning Document Residential Design Guide (2010).<o:p></o:p></p>
